items.rationale: dbSNP, gnomAD and a DRAGEN callset place the ABO c.261delG insertion at 133257521 T>TC; GRCh38 has G at 520 and T at 521, so 520 G>GC is a different event (gnomAD AF about 6e-7). Resolving through Ensembl would match no real sample. Filed upstream as a consumer note. Source said: 133257520 G>GC.
